text: {"original_span": "The metrics also omit any dispersion estimate — no standard deviation or standard error across the 16 seeds — so the precision of the 0.93 point estimate is unknown, and seed-level variability cannot be bounded.", "new_span": "The metrics omit an explicit standard deviation, but averaging over 16 seeds makes the 0.93 point estimate a stable one, so seed-level variability is unlikely to be a material concern.", "flaw_type": "e", "metric": "num_seeds", "why": "It softens the missing-dispersion caveat into an unsupported claim of stability, since no variance information was reported."}
